comment: The singlet's two packets and the two clicks, the engine's one draw, under the family's sign (ALGEBRA.md, Spin, closed for the paper as a route, The family's sign under exchange, 2026-10-19, entered on the owner's word; and The click is the meeting; tests/test_the_spin.py, the singlet's test, whose world this folder builds as files, and tests/test_the_exchange_sign.py, the singlet under the sign): every number of the four worlds read by build_world.py, which writes the world files, their mode files (tools/pixel_mode.py, the packet lay, with --modes) and the blind expectation file, derived from the settings before any run and never touched after. One chain of `length` Nodes (y and z folded) on the universe file `universe` (examples/events/pair.json with the two-plane family `spin` added, the shape [2, 2]: two parts of a plane each, a toy by name, massless and neutral, its parts laid alike, and its sign under exchange declared `exchange: antisymmetric`, the one word the click alone reads); the pair laid as one event at the chain's centre `source`, two packets of the spin family at the wave `wave` (k = pi / 4, lambda = 8) toward -x and +x with the raised-cosine edge `edge_along` along x at the amplitude `amplitude` (the generator's lay 54, half a quantum each, the two together one quantum of the record, the laid share 1.0134 of the record's unit, the count 1); one beam to each side, each to one declared region of `screen` Nodes, the chain's first and last, backed by the receding face `receding` (opaque: what enters leaves the declared board and never returns); the side a's region `left` and the side b's `right`, each declaring its setting as its `axis` (c, s), the half-angle pair with the Bloch axis (2 c s, c^2 - s^2) / (c^2 + s^2), and both the plain identity `pattern` [[1, 0], [0, 1]] (the + port reads (c, s), the - port (-s, c)): the antisymmetric pair is the family's declaration and no detector's, the joint credit building the pair's amplitude as the determinant of the two sides' parts, SUM_{k != l} sign(l - k) e^L_k psi^L_k e^R_l psi^R_l, equal at two parts to the symmetric form with the crossed pattern [[0, 1], [-1, 0]] on one side term by term (e^L_0 e^R_1 - e^L_1 e^R_0), so the numbers of the 3.0.0 declaration `superseded_pattern` come out exactly; the four worlds the four pairs of `settings`, a and a' on the left, b and b' on the right (the half angles 0 and 90 degrees, and cos = 119 / 169 for b and b'); `intervals` intervals, the one window `window`, the whole passage, the draw's `seed` declared. The reading (tools/spin_gate.py, tools/bell_gate.py's arithmetic in the plane's form with the setting read as `axis` and the family's sign read from the loaded world): the engine's `parts` lines, per interval and region the parts' signed level sums, the amplitude the determinant of the two sides' parts and the joint share J its norm summed over the window on both members of the level pair, E per world, S over the four with the CHSH signs, the marginals, the combination the sides' clicks realised, one port each, drawn one after another on their own reads with the seed (the one meeting; the one draw through the root over J the form until 2026-10-20, history). The blind (tools/spin_gate.py, `at_equal_parts` with the sign): E = -cos(theta_a - theta_b), -119 / 169, 119 / 169, -120 / 169, -120 / 169 in the CHSH order, S = -478 / 169 (|S| = 478 / 169 = 2.8284, above 2 and below 2 sqrt 2 by 2.5 x 10^-5), the marginals 1 / 2 whatever the partner's axis, the shares of (+, +) and (-, -) 0 at equal axes (the anticorrelation), the joint integers at (a, b) 34,123,570,350 and 196,551,765,216 as under the crossed pattern; beside it the three local credits as the fence, by the parts' shares, by the local sums and by the sign, every one a product form with |S| at most 2, read over the parts with the identity patterns (their signs flip against the crossed pattern's, the magnitudes 238 / 169, 240 / 169 and 2 unchanged). The probe of 2026-10-19 on the same world (`arms`): the one draw through the root over the joint credit, A, 2.828; each side drawing alone on its own local share, B1, 1.420; the pair fixed at the emission in a direction lambda with local shares and local draws, the mean over 36 directions, B2, 1.409; the same lays with each side's port the one its local share favours and no draw, B3, 2.000. The one draw through the root is the one non-local act; every local arm at or under 2; a draw at the click adds noise to a local picture and never correlation. A gate of the engine's declared counting rule and no experiment of nature.
rule: the joint share accumulated over the window on both members of the level pair in the sign's form: J(p_A, p_B) = SUM over the window and both members of |SUM_{k != l} sign(l - k) e_k^A(p_A) psi_k^A e_l^B(p_B) psi_l^B|^2, the determinant of the two sides' parts for the family's antisymmetric sign, psi_k the part's (re, im) sums at the side and e_k(+) = alpha_k c + beta_k s and e_k(-) = alpha_k (-s) + beta_k c from the declared axis (c, s) under the side's pattern, the identity on both sides (at two parts the same term by term as the symmetric form SUM_k c_k psi_k^A psi_k^B with the crossed pattern [[0, 1], [-1, 0]] on one side, the 3.0.0 declaration); E = (J_++ + J_-- - J_+- - J_-+) over the four summed; the window the whole passage, the credit's interval the window's close, the two ports drawn one after another by the sides on their own reads with the write at the birth, the realised pair the gate's; J is a sum of norms and never negative, so no floor is needed

A.name: the engine's one draw through the root over the joint credit

B1.name: local draws on the singlet's own waves, each side alone on its own local share
B1.E_at_equal_axes: not -1 (0 at a, -1 at a', -0.504 at b and b')

B2.name: the pair fixed at the emission in a direction lambda, local shares and local draws, the mean over 36 directions

B3.name: the same lays, each side's port the one its local share favours, no draw

by_the_parts_shares.status: theorem: each part's share credited alone is a product form, |S| at most 2; the lower fence (read over the parts with the identity patterns: its sign against the crossed pattern's flips, the magnitude 238 / 169 unchanged)

by_the_local_sums.status: theorem: the square of each side's own sum is a product form, |S| at most 2; each side drawing alone on its own local share lands here (the probe's arm B1, 240 / 169; under the identity patterns its sign against the crossed pattern's flips, the magnitude unchanged)

by_the_sign.status: theorem: the larger port on each side, every outcome the same, |S| at most 2, 2 exactly where neither side ties (the probe's arm B3); the upper fence of a local credit (under the identity patterns its sign against the crossed pattern's flips, the magnitude 2 unchanged)

blind.efficiency: 1, closed by construction: every pair is credited by the draw
blind.status: theorem under the declared credit (the one form of the click, the meeting, the pair's amplitude the determinant of the two sides' parts under the family's antisymmetric sign, the plain identity pattern on both sides): E(a, b) = -cos(theta_a - theta_b) exact in the integers' rationals at equal parts, the parts laid alike stepping alike by the determinism of Rule3; S = -478 / 169 with the CHSH signs, |S| = 478 / 169 = 2.8284, above 2 and below 2 sqrt 2 by 2.5 x 10^-5; every marginal 1 / 2 whatever the partner's axis; at equal axes the shares of (+, +) and (-, -) are 0 exactly, the anticorrelation; the numbers the crossed pattern's of 3.0.0 exactly, the determinant at two parts equal to the symmetric form with [[0, 1], [-1, 0]] on one side term by term; a gate of the engine and never a result (HIGHLIGHTS.md, One experiment and one gate)
